question: What determines what is to be worshipped after the fivefold installation is completed?
premises: After that comes the installation of the being of Shiva connected with one's own body.
When this fivefold installation has been performed, primacy within it determines the focus.
The object of worship and ritual attention follows that primacy.
inference: Once the fivefold installation is complete, the element that holds primacy within it becomes the main object of worship.
uncertainties: The verse does not explicitly name the worshipped object, which is clarified in the next verse.
plain_english: Then comes the installation of the being of Shiva, joined with one's own body. When this fivefold set has been performed, whatever holds primacy within it should become the main focus.
